case_title: MOHAMMAD YAZDI VS. KLM AIRLINES BAGGAGE SERVICES

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,495.00 FILED BY YAZDI, MOHAMMAD AS TO DEFENDANT KLM AIRLINES BAGGAGE SERVICES ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-14-2008 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 506

PROOF OF SERVICE NOT ENTERED: INCOMPLETE INFO/PLTFF'S BROTHER, YAZDI MEHSHAD, 40 YRS. OLD, SERVED THE DEFT. (NOTE: MR. MOHAMMAD YAZDI TELEPHONED THE COURT TO NOTIFY THEM THAT THE ENTRY RE: THE POS WAS INCORRECT. THE ROA SHOWED PLAINTIFF AS HAVING SERVED THE DEFENDANT, WHEN IT WAS ACTUALLY HIS BROTHER WHO SERVED THE DEFENDANT.) AFTER REVIEWING THE ORIGINAL POS THE CLERK CHANGED THE ENTRY TO REFLECT THE CORRECT NAME, BUT DID NOT CHANGE THE PART ABOUT SERVICE BEING INCOMPLETE.
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT KLM AIRLINES BAGGAGE SERVICES

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-14-2008 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-14-2008 BY PAUL SLAVIT. ALL PARTIES PRESENT. EXHIBITS FROM BOTH SIDES RETAINED. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. CLERK: S.VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-14-2008 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF YAZDI, MOHAMMAD RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT KLM AIRLINES BAGGAGE SERVICES $175.00 PRINCIPAL, $30.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $205.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED OCT-01-2008 ORDERED DESTROYED
